statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v : V) :
  ‖⟪u,v⟫‖ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖
name: LinearAlgebraGame.Cauchy_Schwarz
content:
The Cauchy-Schwarz inequality: `‖⟪u,v⟫‖ ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖` for any vectors `u` and `v`.
This is one of the most important inequalities in linear algebra and analysis.
